// Badge component for displaying question metadata
QuestionCard.Badge = function QuestionCardBadge({
	children,
	className,
}: {
	children: React.ReactNode;
	className?: string;
}) {
	const { question } = useQuestionCardContext();
	return (
		<motion.span
			initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.8 }}
			animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
			className={cn(
				"flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-violet-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-medium text-[10px] text-violet-600",
				className,
			)}
		>
			{children}
		</motion.span>
	);
};

// Actions component for question card actions (delete, etc.)
QuestionCard.Actions = function QuestionCardActions({
	onDelete,
	isDeleting = false,
	className,
}: {
	onDelete?: () => void;
	isDeleting?: boolean;
	className?: string;
}) {
	const { question, isSelected, isOverlay } = useQuestionCardContext();

	if (isOverlay || !onDelete) {
		return null;
	}

	return (
		<DeleteConfirmButton
			onDelete={onDelete}
			isDeleting={isDeleting}
			className={cn(
				"opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100 data-[selected=true]:opacity-100",
				className,
			)}
			data-selected={isSelected}
		/>
	);
};

// Export the content component for external use
export { QuestionCardContent };

## Refactoring Complete ✅

### Summary

Successfully refactored **24 components** from large monolithic files into focused, single-responsibility modules following Vercel's composition patterns.

### Primitives Created

| Primitive | Location | Purpose |
|-----------|----------|---------|
| `QuestionField` | `survey-runner/questions/` | Standardized question wrapper with label, description, required indicator, error |
| `AnimatedTabButton` | `survey-builder/primitives/` | Tab with Framer Motion animated indicator |
| `InsightCard` | `analytics/primitives/` | Card with built-in loading state for AI insights |
| `ToggleField` | `survey-builder/primitives/` | Switch + label + description pattern |
| `DeleteConfirmButton` | `survey-builder/primitives/` | Two-state delete button with confirmation |
| `FormField` | `forms/` | Shared field with Label, Input, and error display |

### Components Refactored

| Component | Before | After | Structure |
|-----------|--------|-------|-----------|
| question-renderer | 600 lines | 8 files (~40-60 lines each) | Each question type in own file |
| survey-builder/index | 452 lines | 5 files (~80-150 lines) | Context, hooks, overlay extracted |
| logic-rule-form | 379 lines | 4 files (~60-120 lines) | Form fields, constants, types |
| question-palette | 363 lines | 5 files (~30-100 lines) | Buttons, items, constants |
| properties-panel | 334 lines | 5 files (~40-100 lines) | Type editors, hooks |
| builder-canvas | 324 lines | 4 files (~30-120 lines) | Preview, share, drop indicator |
| question-card | 310 lines | 3 files (~60-100 lines) | Compound component pattern |
| survey-runner/context | 294 lines | 3 files (~80-100 lines) | State/actions hooks |
| response-table | 290 lines | 4 files (~50-100 lines) | Columns, filters, pagination |
| question-charts | 263 lines | 3 files (~50-100 lines) | Chart renderer, utils |
| ai-insights | 237 lines | 3 files (~50-100 lines) | Insight card, sentiment bars |

### Key Improvements

1. **Composition over Boolean Props** - QuestionCard uses compound component pattern
2. **Extracted Hooks** - `useDragHandlers`, `useQuestionMutations`, `useRunnerState`, `useRunnerActions`, `useDebouncedSave`
3. **Shared Primitives** - Eliminated duplicate label/description/error patterns
4. **Barrel Exports** - Backward compatible imports maintained
5. **Type Safety** - All TypeScript errors resolved

### Verification

- ✅ `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes with no errors
- ✅ Biome lint/format applied (minor warnings for React keys in charts)

keywords={data.keywords.map((k) => ({

}))}
